title: License required.
bodyText:
[Section effective until June 30, 2026. For section effective July 1, 2026, see below.] Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, it shall be unlawful to represent one's self as a psychologist or engage in the practice of psychology without having first obtained a license as provided in this chapter. [L 1967, c 290, pt of §1; HRS §465-2; am L 1971, c 84, §2; am L 1985, c 115, §4]

§465-2 License required. [Section effective July 1, 2026. For section effective until June 30, 2026, see above.] Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, it shall be unlawful to represent one's self as a psychologist or an associate psychologist or engage in the practice of psychology without having first obtained a license as provided in this chapter.
